sloka: एतावदुक्त्वा चोत्थाय काकुत्स्थः परमासनात् ।पर्यष्वजत धर्मात्मा निरन्तरमुरोगतम् ।। ७.३८.१९ ॥
transliteration: etāvaduktvā cotthāya kākutsthaḥ paramāsanāt ।paryaṣvajata dharmātmā nirantaramurogatam ।। 7.38.19 ॥

translations.english: Having said this much, the righteous Rama rose from his excellent seat and embraced him closely to his chest.
